title: PromptPic: One-click AI prompts for ads, portraits & product shots. | Product Hunt
excerpt: Find premium, copy-paste-ready prompts for Midjourney, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Flux. PromptPic separates prompts into Personal and Commercial modes, so creators and brands get exactly what they need. Start free with 5 copies/day, then grab lifetime Pro for ₹999 during launch.
